segments.sn35.93:1.2: Kathañca, bhikkhave, dvayaṃ paṭicca viññāṇaṃ sambhoti?
segments.sn35.93:1.3: Cakkhuñca paṭicca rūpe ca uppajjati cakkhuviññāṇaṃ.
segments.sn35.93:1.6: Itthetaṃ dvayaṃ calañceva byathañca aniccaṃ vipariṇāmi aññathābhāvi.
segments.sn35.93:1.8: Yopi hetu yopi paccayo cakkhuviññāṇassa uppādāya, sopi hetu sopi paccayo anicco vipariṇāmī aññathābhāvī.
segments.sn35.93:1.9: Aniccaṃ kho pana, bhikkhave, paccayaṃ paṭicca uppannaṃ cakkhuviññāṇaṃ kuto niccaṃ bhavissati!
segments.sn35.93:1.10: Yā kho, bhikkhave, imesaṃ tiṇṇaṃ dhammānaṃ saṅgati sannipāto samavāyo, ayaṃ vuccati cakkhusamphasso.
segments.sn35.93:1.12: Yopi hetu yopi paccayo cakkhusamphassassa uppādāya, sopi hetu sopi paccayo anicco vipariṇāmī aññathābhāvī.
segments.sn35.93:1.13: Aniccaṃ kho pana, bhikkhave, paccayaṃ paṭicca uppanno cakkhusamphasso kuto nicco bhavissati!
segments.sn35.93:1.14: Phuṭṭho, bhikkhave, vedeti, phuṭṭho ceteti, phuṭṭho sañjānāti.
segments.sn35.93:1.15: Itthetepi dhammā calā ceva byathā ca aniccā vipariṇāmino aññathābhāvino. Sotaṃ … pe ….
segments.sn35.93:2.4: Itthetaṃ dvayaṃ calañceva byathañca aniccaṃ vipariṇāmi aññathābhāvi.
segments.sn35.93:2.6: Yopi hetu yopi paccayo jivhāviññāṇassa uppādāya, sopi hetu sopi paccayo anicco vipariṇāmī aññathābhāvī.
segments.sn35.93:2.7: Aniccaṃ kho pana, bhikkhave, paccayaṃ paṭicca uppannaṃ jivhāviññāṇaṃ, kuto niccaṃ bhavissati!
segments.sn35.93:2.8: Yā kho, bhikkhave, imesaṃ tiṇṇaṃ dhammānaṃ saṅgati sannipāto samavāyo, ayaṃ vuccati jivhāsamphasso.
segments.sn35.93:2.10: Yopi hetu yopi paccayo jivhāsamphassassa uppādāya, sopi hetu sopi paccayo anicco vipariṇāmī aññathābhāvī.
segments.sn35.93:2.11: Aniccaṃ kho pana, bhikkhave, paccayaṃ paṭicca uppanno jivhāsamphasso, kuto nicco bhavissati!
segments.sn35.93:2.12: Phuṭṭho, bhikkhave, vedeti, phuṭṭho ceteti, phuṭṭho sañjānāti.
segments.sn35.93:2.13: Itthetepi dhammā calā ceva byathā ca aniccā vipariṇāmino aññathābhāvino. Kāyaṃ … pe ….
segments.sn35.93:3.4: Itthetaṃ dvayaṃ calañceva byathañca aniccaṃ vipariṇāmi aññathābhāvi.
segments.sn35.93:3.6: Yopi hetu yopi paccayo manoviññāṇassa uppādāya, sopi hetu sopi paccayo anicco vipariṇāmī aññathābhāvī.
segments.sn35.93:3.7: Aniccaṃ kho pana, bhikkhave, paccayaṃ paṭicca uppannaṃ manoviññāṇaṃ, kuto niccaṃ bhavissati!
segments.sn35.93:3.8: Yā kho, bhikkhave, imesaṃ tiṇṇaṃ dhammānaṃ saṅgati sannipāto samavāyo, ayaṃ vuccati manosamphasso.
segments.sn35.93:3.10: Yopi hetu yopi paccayo manosamphassassa uppādāya, sopi hetu sopi paccayo anicco vipariṇāmī aññathābhāvī.
segments.sn35.93:3.11: Aniccaṃ kho pana, bhikkhave, paccayaṃ paṭicca uppanno manosamphasso, kuto nicco bhavissati!
segments.sn35.93:3.12: Phuṭṭho, bhikkhave, vedeti, phuṭṭho ceteti, phuṭṭho sañjānāti.
segments.sn35.93:3.13: Itthetepi dhammā calā ceva byathā ca aniccā vipariṇāmino aññathābhāvino.
segments.sn35.93:3.14: Evaṃ kho, bhikkhave, dvayaṃ paṭicca viññāṇaṃ sambhotī”ti.
segments.sn35.93:4.1: Palokasuññā saṃkhittaṃ, channo puṇṇo ca bāhiyo;
segments.sn35.93:4.3: Ejena ca duve vuttā, dvayehi apare duveti.

lines: Calañceva byathañcāti attano sabhāvena asaṇṭhahanato calati ceva byathati ca.
Yopi hetu yopi paccayoti cakkhuviññāṇassa vatthārammaṇaṃ hetu ceva paccayo ca.
Kuto niccaṃ bhavissatīti kena kāraṇena niccaṃ bhavissati.
Yathā pana dāsassa dāsiyā kucchismiṃ jāto putto parova dāso hoti, evaṃ aniccameva hotīti attho.
Ayaṃ vuccati cakkhusamphassoti iminā saṅgatisannipātasamavāyasaṅkhātena paccayena uppannattā paccayanāmeneva saṅgati sannipāto samavāyoti ayaṃ vuccati cakkhusamphasso.
Sopi hetūti phassassa vatthu ārammaṇaṃ sahajātā tayo khandhāti ayaṃ hetu.
Phuṭṭhoti upayogatthe paccattaṃ, phassena phuṭṭhameva gocaraṃ vedanā vedeti, cetanā ceteti, saññā sañjānātīti attho.
Phuṭṭhoti vā phassasamaṅgīpuggalo, phassena phuṭṭhārammaṇameva vedanādīhi vedeti ceteti sañjānātītipi vuttaṃ hoti.
Iti imasmiṃ sutte samatiṃsakkhandhā kathitā honti.
Cakkhudvāre tāva vatthu ceva ārammaṇañca rūpakkhandho, phuṭṭho vedetīti vedanākkhandho, cetetīti saṅkhārakkhandho, sañjānātīti saññākkhandho, vijānātīti viññāṇakkhandhoti.
Manodvārepi hi vatthurūpaṃ ekantato rūpakkhandho, rūpe pana ārammaṇe sati ārammaṇampi rūpakkhandhoti cha pañcakātiṃsa honti.
Saṅkhepena panete chasupi dvāresu pañceva khandhāti sapaccaye pañcakkhandhe aniccāti vitthāretvā vuccamāne bujjhanakānaṃ ajjhāsayena idaṃ suttaṃ desitanti.
Pāḷiyaṃ āmeḍitalopena niddesoti āha “dve dve koṭṭhāse”ti.
Yasmā ca saṃgacchamānadhammavimuttā saṅgati nāma natthi, tathā sannipātasamavāyā, tesaṃ vasena nibbatto phasso tathā vuccatīti.

Phassenātiādīsu ayaṃ saṅkhepattho – yasmā rūpārammaṇe phasse attano phusanakiccaṃ karonte evaṃ vedanā anubhavanakiccaṃ, saññā sañjānanakiccaṃ karoti, tasmā “phassena phuṭṭhamevā”tiādivuttameva atthaṃ idāni puggalādhiṭṭhānena dassetuṃ “phuṭṭho”tiādi vuttaṃ.
Pañceva khandhā bhagavatā samatiṃsāya ākārehi vuttā.
Rukkhasākhāsu rukkhavohāro viya ekekadhammepi khandhavohāro hotiyeva.
